# UDPipe 1.4.0 source import

Unmodified official library-only sources from
https://github.com/ufal/udpipe/releases/download/v1.4.0/udpipe-1.4.0-bin.zip
(archive SHA-256 `457f541e204737d354c749b473060a28b2debf625f23075543d9eba78be016c1`).
Reproduce with `python scripts/vendor_udpipe.py`. The importer extracts only
`src_lib_only/udpipe.cpp`, `src_lib_only/udpipe.h`, and `LICENSE`.
The upstream MPL-2.0 licence and notices apply; sources are shipped in the sdist.
The quotation bridge is maintained separately in `src/quotation/`.

- `udpipe.cpp`: `2d91f529e43bd235858daeaa2c1fb1c6e237180e8433adeab2e5f880173cbba5`
- `udpipe.h`: `52a2d329e8e4407fc40d6a4cc7bc6be4435c5e56fea067acebce049987e19101`
- `LICENSE`: `1f256ecad192880510e84ad60474eab7589218784b9a50bc7ceee34c2b91f1d5`
